[[Sreelekha Mitra]] is an Indian actress who is known for her work in Bengali cinema and television. Her first Acting stint was ''Balikar Prem'', a Bengali TV series by [[Dulal Lahiri]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-08-30 |script-title=bn:বন্ধুদের সঙ্গে নিয়ে জন্মদিনের পার্টিতে আনন্দে ভাসলেন শ্রীলেখা, শেয়ার করলেন একাধিক ছবি |url=https://bengali.abplive.com/photo-gallery/entertainment/today-is-the-birthday-of-popular-bengali-film-actress-sreelekha-mitra-916346 |access-date=2023-02-14 |work=ABP Live |language=bn}}</ref> She then appeared in two odia films but those did not take off her career. After she bagged the role of Nabanita in ''Trishna'' (1996), a Bengali TV series directed by Anindya Sarkar, she went on to appear in a string of Bengali TV series and films.<ref>{{Cite news |date= |script-title=bn:আমি মরলে আমায় নিয়ে যেন মিডিয়ায় সার্কাস না হয় : শ্রীলেখা |url=https://www.kalerkantho.com/online/entertainment/2022/03/25/1132230 |access-date=18 February 2023 |work=Kaler Kantho |language=bn}}</ref>

Mitra starred in [[Basu Chatterjee]]'s ''[[Hothat Brishti]]'' (1998) which became a major commercial success. She did not experience a significant elevation in her career as she did not reciprocate to [[Prosenjit Chatterjee]]'s love for her.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sreelekha Mitra blasts Prosenjit Chatterjee over 'favouritism' in Tollywood {{!}} Indiablooms - First Portal on Digital News Management |url=https://www.indiablooms.com/showbiz-details/T/12951/sreelekha-mitra-blasts-prosenjit-chatterjee-over-favouritism-in-tollywood.html |access-date=2023-03-07 |website=Indiablooms.com |language=en}}</ref>

[[Category:Actress filmographies]]
[[Category:Indian filmographies]]
extract:
Sreelekha Mitra is an Indian actress who is known for her work in Bengali cinema and television. Her first Acting stint was Balikar Prem, a Bengali TV series by Dulal Lahiri. She then appeared in two odia films but those did not take off her career. After she bagged the role of Nabanita in Trishna (1996), a Bengali TV series directed by Anindya Sarkar, she went on to appear in a string of Bengali TV series and films.
Mitra starred in Basu Chatterjee's Hothat Brishti (1998) which became a major commercial success. She did not experience a significant elevation in her career as she did not reciprocate to Prosenjit Chatterjee's love for her.
